description: Brannstasjoner is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Direktoratet for samfunnssikkerhet og beredskap. Datasettet viser alle brannstasjoner og en del av brannvesenets depoter i Norge. Målsettingen med stedfestingen er å stedfeste til riktig bygning, men kvaliteten er varierende. Egenskapsinformasjon og oppdatering er basert på en årlig innrapportering fra landets brannvesen til DSB. Coverage: Norway. The publisher named on the listing is Direktoratet for samfunnssikkerhet og beredskap. Its keywords include samfunnssikkerhet, Utility and governmental services, fellesDatakatalog, Brann, Norge digitalt, beredskap. The listing shows 5 download or service links in GML, GDB, XML, SQL. The listing shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
